name: Bokura no Triangle
source:
Three boys have been friends since elementary school. Even though they attend different clubs now, their friendship is the most precious thing in their hearts.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
三个男孩从小学起就是朋友。虽然如今参加了不同的社团，但他们的友谊依然是心中最珍贵的东西。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
